chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Who counts as a jazz singer
summary: They run through Billie Holiday, Ethel Waters, Carmen McRae, Sarah Vaughan, Anita O'Day and Betty Carter and the swing versus modern distinction.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
